acs.text_first_line: Scenario: AC1 The chart deploys the api and the worker from one artefact (new, D-RCV-60)
Scenario: AC2 The rwb_agent login and the Flyway run are in place (new, D-RCV-60)
Scenario: AC3 The worker polls rwb-agent in namespace rwb-recovery and scales on backlog (new, D-RCV-60)
Scenario: AC4 The L1 run is registered as an event-started workflow and no Schedule exists (new, D-RCV-60)
Scenario: AC5 The topic, the record feed and the consumer groups are provisioned (new, D-RCV-60)
Scenario: AC6 The reads are wired by contract, secrets are references and egress is closed (new, D-RCV-60)
Scenario: AC7 Probes, scaling and the smoke read answer (new, D-RCV-60)
Scenario: AC8 The dashboards, the alerts and the runbook cover the L1 gate (new, D-RCV-60)
Scenario: AC9 The route is published and the runbook, the rollback and the capacity plan are accepted (new, D-RCV-60)

ops_provided: GET /api/recovery/agent/v1/cases/{caseId}/agent-outputs, published behind the gateway-bff pass-through route

ops_consumed: rwb-case the case-decision proposal operation (path not specified; RWB-P3-E1035-CON)
the ACE PostgreSQL database, schema rwb_agent and its login
the Kafka cluster with rwb.agent.events.v1, rwb.decision-record.v1 and rwb.case.events.v1
the Temporal cluster, namespace rwb-recovery and the task queue rwb-agent
the platform secret store, the platform feature-flag library and the gateway-bff route
the model endpoint INT-23 through the agent platform of the earlier P10 stories

rwb.decision-record.v1 verified with its retry and .dlt topics and the publish right of the library

AgentRunWorkflow registration with ResolveIntakeMode and RecordIntakeFeedback
no Schedule is registered: the L1 run is event-started and no cadence belongs to it
